annotatedSteps.description: Convert dimensions to cm and find prime factors
annotatedSteps.studentWork:
Length = 9.75 m = 975 cm, Breadth = 6.75 m = 675 cm, Height = 5.25 m = 525 cm

675 = 3³ × 5²
525 = 3 × 5² × 7

annotatedSteps.description: Calculate HCF and state longest ruler
annotatedSteps.studentWork:

∴ Longest ruler = 675 cm = 6.75 m
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Confused HCF with LCM definition (took highest powers instead of lowest powers)

∴ Longest ruler = 75 cm (or 0.75 m)

2000 - (2000 - 180x + 4x²) = 1184
180x - 4x² = 1184
x² - 45x + 296 = 0

x = 37 is rejected (40 - 2x would be negative) ⇒ x = 8
